blocks.html:
Carbon monoxide detectors shall be provided in all fuel-fired appliance rooms to detect the level of carbon monoxide in the room and signal an alarm. Such detectors shall be listed and installed in accordance with Chapter 9 of the New York City Building Code.
Section MC 1007: Boiler Low-Water Cutoff
